obs_description.orientation: base orientation as rotation vector (rad), world frame
obs_description.angular_vel: base angular velocity (rad/s), world frame, clipped to +-8
obs_description.vel: base linear velocity (m/s), world frame, clipped to +-8
obs_description.motor_state: 3 wheel speeds divided by max_wheel_velocity (30), clipped to +-2
obs_description.cmd: velocity command [vx, vy (m/s), yaw rate (rad/s)], world frame
obs_description.heading: [sin(yaw), cos(yaw)] of the base
obs_description.vint: clipped integral of the planar velocity error, += (cmd - vel) * 0.01 each control step

action.to_ctrl: ctrl = -clip(a * max_wheel_velocity, +-max_wheel_velocity) (motor torque in N m, applied to actuators 0..2)
